name: chat-composer
title: Chat Composer
description: The box a person talks to an agent in: chips for what travels with the message, the text with mentions, and Send, which turns into Stop while the agent answers.

meta.whenToUse: Talking to an agent: a chat side panel, an agent's page, a full chat.
meta.whenNotToUse: A comment or a reply on a record (CommentComposer), or a one-line prompt in a popover (Textarea in an InputGroup).
